metadata.dataset_description: One continuous courier workday containing 17 delivery-location visits, task counts per visit, and timestamped GPS activity states. Road reconstruction: 1032 GPS points along the archived local OSM street network, with all road vertices retained and irregular moving intervals bounded by 45 m. Oneway tags are respected; turn-restriction relations are not modeled. Times are local Shanghai time; speed_kmh and activity_state describe the preceding segment. Task events and AOI locations are constructed, not authentic observations.

insight_list.question: How is the observed workday divided between travel and time near delivery locations?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Calculate durations from consecutive trajectory states and compare their totals.
insight_list.code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def allocation(df, user_df):
    import matplotlib.dates as mdates
    from matplotlib.patches import Patch

    q = user_df.sort_values('gps_time').copy()
    stamps = pd.to_datetime(q.gps_time, format='mixed')
    minutes = stamps.diff().dt.total_seconds()/60
    totals = minutes.groupby(q.activity_state).sum()
    colors = {'travelling': '#397aa7', 'near_delivery_location': '#c7813e'}
    fig, (timeline, total) = plt.subplots(
        2, 1, figsize=(11.8, 6.3), constrained_layout=True,
        gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [1, 1.1]})
    # Each row's state describes its PRECEDING GPS interval.
    for i in range(1, len(q)):
        timeline.barh(0, mdates.date2num(stamps.iloc[i])-mdates.date2num(stamps.iloc[i-1]),
            left=mdates.date2num(stamps.iloc[i-1]), height=.55,
            color=colors[q.activity_state.iloc[i]], linewidth=0)
    timeline.set(ylim=(-.6, 1.1), yticks=[], xlabel='Local Shanghai time',
        title='Observed workday activity sequence')
    timeline.xaxis_date()
    timeline.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%H:%M'))
    timeline.legend(handles=[Patch(color=colors['travelling'], label='Travelling'),
        Patch(color=colors['near_delivery_location'], label='Near delivery locations')],
        loc='upper center', ncol=2, frameon=False)
    values = [float(totals['travelling']), float(totals['near_delivery_location'])]
    total.barh(['Travelling', 'Near delivery locations'], values,
        color=list(colors.values()), height=.55)
    for y, v in enumerate(values): total.text(v+3, y, f'{v:.0f} min', va='center')
    total.set(xlim=(0, max(values)*1.18), xlabel='Total observed time (minutes)',
        title='Time near delivery locations exceeds travel time')
    for ax in [timeline, total]:
        ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    return {'travelling_minutes': round(values[0], 1), 'near_delivery_minutes': round(values[1], 1)}

evidence = allocation(df, user_df)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

insight_list.code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def visit_counts(df, user_df):
    ordered = df.sort_values('visit_duration_min')
    longest = ordered.iloc[-1]
    colors = ['#b75858' if r.visit_id == longest.visit_id else '#4d8977'
        if r.completed_deliveries > 1 else '#9aa7b1' for r in ordered.itertuples()]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.6, 7.0), constrained_layout=True)
    ax.barh(ordered.visit_id, ordered.visit_duration_min, color=colors, height=.68)
    for y, row in enumerate(ordered.itertuples()):
        n = int(row.completed_deliveries)
        label = f"{n} {'delivery' if n == 1 else 'deliveries'}"
        if row.visit_id == longest.visit_id: label += ' · longest visit'
        ax.text(row.visit_duration_min+.25, y, label, va='center', fontsize=10,
            fontweight='bold' if row.visit_id == longest.visit_id else 'normal')
    ax.set(xlim=(0, longest.visit_duration_min*1.46), xlabel='Visit duration (minutes)',
        ylabel='Visit', title='Duration and completed deliveries for every visit')
    ax.set_axisbelow(True); ax.grid(axis='x', alpha=.18)
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    return {'longest_visit_id': str(longest.visit_id), 'duration_minutes': float(longest.visit_duration_min),
        'completed_deliveries': int(longest.completed_deliveries)}

evidence = visit_counts(df, user_df)
print(evidence)
plt.show()
